scenario: 设计 Stripe/PayPal 级的支付欺诈检测,sub-50ms 打分、成本非对称、欺诈是稀有事件,而且欺诈者会主动适应你的特征。
scenario_en: Designing Stripe/PayPal-scale payment fraud detection: sub-50ms scoring, asymmetric cost, fraud is rare, and fraudsters actively adapt to your features.
q: 欺诈检测的特征体系由哪几大家族构成,为什么特征工程是这类面试的胜负手？
q_en: What feature families make up fraud detection, and why is feature engineering the make-or-break of these interviews?
why: 四大表格特征家族(交易、行为、设备指纹、速度)+ 图特征(抓协同团伙)。特征工程是胜负手,因为它暴露你懂不懂 adversarial dynamics——欺诈者会主动适应、绕过任何单一特征,所以要靠互补的多家族叠加,而不是押注一个信号。
why_en: Four tabular families (transaction, behavioral, device, velocity) plus graph features for rings, and feature engineering wins interviews because it reveals whether you grasp adversarial dynamics — fraudsters adapt around any single feature.
diagram:
flowchart LR T["交易特征"] --> M["欺诈打分"] B["行为特征"] --> M D["设备指纹"] --> M V["速度特征"] --> M G["图特征
团伙协同"] --> M
options: 只要一个足够强的交易金额特征,别的都是冗余
四大表格家族(交易/行为/设备/速度)+图特征;特征工程是胜负手,因为它暴露你懂不懂欺诈者会主动适应
只靠一个黑箱大模型吃原始交易流,不需要特征工程
靠固定规则黑名单即可,欺诈者不会变
options_en: One strong transaction-amount feature suffices; the rest is redundant.
Four tabular families (transaction/behavioral/device/velocity) plus graph features; feature engineering is the make-or-break because it reveals whether you grasp that fraudsters adapt.
Just one black-box model over the raw transaction stream, no feature engineering.
A fixed blacklist of rules is enough; fraudsters don't change.
optionExplanations: 单一金额特征易被欺诈者模仿正常金额绕过,必须多家族互补。
对;多家族+图特征互补应对适应性攻击,特征工程正是考 adversarial 理解的地方。
黑箱吃原始流缺少领域特征,面试也考不出你对欺诈动态的理解。
欺诈者持续演化,固定黑名单几周就失效,是被明确否定的静态思路。
optionExplanations_en: A single amount feature is easily bypassed by mimicking normal amounts; complementary families are required.
Correct — complementary families plus graph features counter adaptive attacks, and feature engineering is exactly where adversarial understanding is tested.
A black box over the raw stream lacks domain features and can't showcase your grasp of fraud dynamics.
Fraudsters evolve, so a fixed blacklist fails within weeks — the explicitly rejected static mindset.

termDefinitions.meaning: 欺诈者主动观察并规避你的检测特征,任何静态单一信号都会被适应绕过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adversarial dynamics is that fraudsters actively probe and evade your detection features, so any static single signal gets adapted around.

termDefinitions.meaning: 漏放一笔欺诈的代价与误拦一笔正常交易的代价差别很大,阈值要按此不对称设。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Asymmetric cost means missing fraud and false-declining a legit transaction cost very differently, so thresholds are set around that imbalance.

scenario: 五大特征家族在计算时机上很不一样:有的请求到达即取,有的要预计算,有的靠流式计数,有的要异步批处理。
scenario_en: The five families differ in computation timing: some extracted on arrival, some precomputed, some streaming counters, some async batch.
q: 关于各特征家族的计算时机,哪些配对是对的？(多选)
q_en: Which family-to-timing pairings are correct? (multiple)
why: 交易特征=请求到达即时提取(原始上下文);行为特征=预计算成用户画像向量、按小时刷新,打分时取;速度特征=每事件流式计数器(Redis/DynamoDB);图特征=异步批处理算好、缓存进 feature store。设备指纹=实时查带缓存画像。计算时机不同决定了它们各自的延迟与新鲜度约束。
why_en: Transaction = real-time extraction on arrival; behavioral = precomputed user-profile vectors refreshed hourly; velocity = streaming counters per event; graph = async batch cached in the feature store.
options: 交易特征:请求到达即时提取(金额/币种/MCC/geo 等原始上下文)
行为特征:预计算成用户画像向量、按小时刷新,打分时检索
速度特征:每事件更新的流式计数器(tx/小时、distinct 商户/天)
图特征:必须在 sub-50ms 实时路径里做两跳遍历现算
options_en: Transaction: real-time extraction on arrival (amount/currency/MCC/geo raw context).
Behavioral: precomputed user-profile vectors refreshed hourly, retrieved at scoring.
Velocity: streaming counters updated per event (tx/hour, distinct merchants/day).
Graph: must do two-hop traversal live in the sub-50ms real-time path.
optionExplanations: 对;交易特征是请求自带的原始字段,到达即可提取,零预计算。
对;行为画像离线预计算、按小时刷新,打分时低延迟检索。
对;速度是滑窗计数,流式每事件累加,存 Redis/DynamoDB 供快取。
错;两跳图遍历跑不进 50ms,必须异步批处理预算好、缓存节点属性,实时只取缓存。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — transaction features are raw request fields, extractable on arrival with zero precomputation.
Correct — behavioral profiles are precomputed offline and refreshed hourly for low-latency retrieval at scoring.
Correct — velocity is sliding-window counts accumulated per event in Redis/DynamoDB for fast lookup.
Wrong — two-hop graph traversal can't fit in 50ms, so it's async-batch precomputed with cached node attributes retrieved in real time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 商户类别码:标识商户行业(餐饮/加油/珠宝…)的四位码,是交易上下文特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MCC (Merchant Category Code) is a four-digit code identifying the merchant's industry, a transaction-context feature.

termDefinitions.meaning: 统一存取预计算特征的系统,离线算好、在线低延迟检索,保证训练与服务一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store serves precomputed features, computed offline and retrieved online at low latency, keeping training and serving consistent.

scenario: 一笔交易刚到达,你手上只有原始字段:金额、币种、MCC、卡在场/不在场、商户 geo、时间戳。
scenario_en: A transaction just arrived and you only have raw fields: amount, currency, MCC, card-present/not, merchant geo, timestamp.
q: 为什么只靠这些交易特征很弱,该补什么才能变强？
q_en: Why are these transaction features weak alone, and what makes them strong?
why: 交易特征是无个人上下文的原始值,欺诈者能轻松模仿'正常'金额和商户,单看每笔都合理。要补行为特征给出该用户的'正常'基线——$3000 相对这个用户是不是异常,取决于他平时花多少。缺了基线,交易特征无法判断偏离。
why_en: Transaction features are raw context with no personal baseline, and fraudsters easily mimic normal amounts and merchants, so each looks fine alone — behavioral features supply the user's 'normal' so deviations become informative.
tradeoff: 交易特征(即时可得但无基线、易被模仿) vs 叠加行为基线(能判异常但需预计算画像)
options: 交易特征已经够强,不需要任何补充
交易特征是无基线的原始值、易被模仿正常;要补行为特征给出该用户的'正常'基线才能判异常
该补更多交易字段(如更精确的时间戳)就够了
该把金额直接当欺诈概率,金额越大越欺诈
options_en: Transaction features are already strong; no supplement needed.
Transaction features are raw with no baseline and easily mimicked as normal; add behavioral features giving the user's 'normal' to judge deviation.
Just add more transaction fields (a more precise timestamp) and it's enough.
Use amount directly as fraud probability — bigger amount, more fraud.
whenOtherWins: 对完全没有历史的全新账户(冷启动),暂时没有行为基线可比,只能先靠交易特征 + 人群基线,并对新账户用更严阈值兜底。
whenOtherWins_en: For brand-new accounts with no history (cold start), there's no behavioral baseline yet, so lean on transaction features plus population baselines and stricter thresholds.
optionExplanations: 交易特征单看每笔都'正常',欺诈者正是靠模仿正常绕过,并不够强。
对;补上用户'正常'基线后,同一笔金额的异常程度才判得出来,弱特征变强。
再多原始交易字段仍缺'相对这个用户是否异常'的基线,补不到点子上。
金额大不等于欺诈(正常也有大额),直接当概率会误伤大量正常交易。
optionExplanations_en: Each transaction feature looks normal alone, which is exactly how fraudsters bypass by mimicking normal — not strong enough.
Correct — with the user's normal baseline, the same amount's anomaly becomes judgeable, turning weak features strong.
More raw transaction fields still lack the 'anomalous relative to this user' baseline — off the mark.
A big amount isn't fraud (legit large purchases exist), and using it as probability false-declines many legit transactions.

termDefinitions.term: card-present vs card-not-present / 卡在场 vs 不在场
termDefinitions.meaning: 刷实体卡(在场)与线上无卡(CNP)交易,CNP 欺诈风险更高,是交易上下文特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Card-present (physical swipe) vs card-not-present (online, CNP) transactions; CNP carries higher fraud risk, a transaction-context feature.

scenario: 同一笔交易:金额 $3000、凌晨 3 点、一个从没去过的商户类别、离常用地点很远。
scenario_en: One transaction: $3000, at 3 AM, a never-before-seen merchant category, far from the usual location.
q: 行为特征怎么把这几个信号组合成强欺诈信号？
q_en: How do behavioral features combine these into a strong fraud signal?
why: 行为特征给每个维度一个该用户的'正常'基线(30 天均额、常用 MCC、常去 geo 质心、习惯时段)。任一异常单看都可解释(偶尔熬夜大额),但多个异常叠加(大额+凌晨+新类别+异地)构成强复合信号。这些画像离线预计算、打分时检索。
why_en: Behavioral features give each dimension the user's normal baseline (30-day avg, typical MCC, geo centroid, usual times); any single anomaly is explainable alone, but stacked anomalies compose a strong composite signal.
tradeoff: 多异常叠加为复合信号(强但需完整用户画像) vs 单维阈值(简单但每维都可能是正常波动)
options: 只要金额超某固定阈值就报欺诈,不看用户基线
给每维一个该用户的正常基线,多个异常(大额+凌晨+新类别+异地)叠加成强复合信号
只看时间,凌晨交易一律拦
把四个信号分别独立报警,不做组合
options_en: Flag fraud whenever the amount exceeds a fixed threshold, ignoring the user baseline.
Give each dimension the user's normal baseline; stacked anomalies (big + 3 AM + new category + far) compose a strong composite signal.
Look only at time and block all 3 AM transactions.
Alert on each of the four signals independently with no combination.
whenOtherWins: 若某维度本身就是硬约束(如该卡明确禁用于某高危 MCC),那单维规则直接拦即可,不必等复合信号叠加。
whenOtherWins_en: If a dimension is itself a hard rule (this card is barred from a high-risk MCC), a single-dimension block applies directly without waiting for a composite.
optionExplanations: 固定金额阈值无视用户基线,对高消费用户误伤、对低消费用户漏放。
对;个体基线让每维异常可量化,多异常叠加才是行为特征的强判据。
凌晨交易很多是正常的,单看时间一刀切会大量误伤。
独立报警丢掉了'多异常同时出现'这个最强的复合信息。
optionExplanations_en: A fixed amount threshold ignores the user baseline, false-declining high spenders and missing low spenders.
Correct — per-user baselines quantify each anomaly, and stacked anomalies are the strong basis of behavioral features.
Many 3 AM transactions are legit, so a blanket time rule false-declines heavily.
Independent alerts lose the strongest signal — multiple anomalies co-occurring.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户常用交易地点的中心,当前交易离它多远是行为异常的一个维度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The geo centroid is the center of a user's usual transaction locations; distance from it is one behavioral-anomaly dimension.

termDefinitions.meaning: 刻画用户'正常'的预计算向量(均额、常用 MCC、时段、geo),打分时检索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A behavioral profile is a precomputed vector of a user's normal (avg amount, typical MCC, times, geo), retrieved at scoring.

scenario: 新注册、交易极少的账户,几乎没有行为历史可比;而这类账户恰恰被欺诈者盯得最紧。
scenario_en: Newly registered accounts with almost no history — exactly the ones fraudsters target most.
q: 冷启动账户没有行为基线,该怎么处理才不被钻空子？
q_en: With no behavioral baseline for cold-start accounts, how do you avoid being exploited?
why: 冷启动账户没个人历史→行为异常判不了→欺诈者专挑这类下手。兜底两步:用人群/同类群(cohort)基线代替个人基线;并对交易数 <10 的账户上更严的阈值。承认没有个人信号时,用群体先验+更保守阈值补上,而不是默认放行。
why_en: No history means no behavioral deviation to judge, and fraudsters target these accounts, so substitute population/cohort baselines and apply stricter thresholds for accounts with under 10 transactions.
options: 冷启动账户默认放行,等攒够历史再管
没个人基线→异常判不了→被专门针对;用人群/cohort 基线代替,并对 <10 笔交易的账户上更严阈值
对所有新账户一律拦截,直到人工审核
给新账户随机分配一个老用户的画像当基线
options_en: Default new accounts to approve until they accumulate history.
No personal baseline → can't judge deviation → targeted; substitute population/cohort baselines and apply stricter thresholds for accounts with under 10 transactions.
Block all new accounts until manual review.
Assign each new account a random existing user's profile as its baseline.
optionExplanations: 默认放行正中欺诈者下怀,冷启动账户被针对时几乎无防护。
对;人群/cohort 基线填补缺失的个人信号,更严阈值对冲更高的欺诈风险。
一律拦截人工审在规模上不可行,还严重伤害正常新用户体验。
随机套用他人画像制造错误基线,判异常会系统性出错。
optionExplanations_en: Default-approve plays into fraudsters' hands; targeted cold-start accounts get almost no protection.
Correct — population/cohort baselines fill the missing personal signal, and stricter thresholds hedge the higher fraud risk.
Blocking all for manual review is infeasible at scale and badly hurts legit new users.
Borrowing a random profile creates a wrong baseline, systematically misjudging anomalies.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新用户/新账户缺历史时无法用个人基线,需人群或同类群基线兜底。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is when a new user/account lacks history, so population or cohort baselines must fill in.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同类用户群体的聚合'正常'基线,给缺个人历史的账户当参照。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cohort profile is the aggregated 'normal' baseline of a similar user group, used as a reference for accounts lacking personal history.

scenario: 想识别'同一台设备在批量注册/操作多个账户',以及'一个已知用户换了新设备'。
scenario_en: You want to detect 'one device operating many accounts' and 'a known user on a new device'.
q: 设备指纹该怎么构造,能抓到什么信号？
q_en: How is a device fingerprint built, and what signal does it catch?
why: 把浏览器属性+OS+屏幕分辨率+字体+时区+IP geo 组合成一个伪唯一 ID。它能抓两类信号:一台设备关联很多账户(团伙/批量欺诈的强信号),以及已知用户出现在新设备上(账户接管的可疑信号)。单个属性都不唯一,组合起来才有区分度。
why_en: Combine browser attributes + OS + screen resolution + fonts + timezone + IP geo into a pseudo-unique ID that catches one device linked to many accounts (a ring signal) and a known user on a new device.
tradeoff: 设备指纹(抓一机多号/换机但可被伪造) vs 只看账户级特征(漏掉跨账户的设备共用)
options: 只用 IP 地址当设备身份,IP 相同就算同设备
把浏览器属性+OS+分辨率+字体+时区+IP geo 组合成伪唯一 ID,抓'一机多号'和'已知用户换新机'
只用登录用户名区分设备
给每台设备发一个永久 cookie,清了就当新设备
options_en: Use only the IP address as device identity; same IP means same device.
Combine browser attributes + OS + resolution + fonts + timezone + IP geo into a pseudo-unique ID, catching 'one device many accounts' and 'known user on a new device'.
Distinguish devices only by the logged-in username.
Issue each device a permanent cookie and treat cleared cookies as new devices.
whenOtherWins: 若你能拿到平台原生 app 的可信硬件级设备 ID(如移动端安全芯片证明),那比浏览器熵拼的指纹更可靠,可直接用它做设备身份。
whenOtherWins_en: If you have a trusted hardware-level device ID from a native app (a mobile secure-element attestation), it beats browser-entropy fingerprints and can be used directly.
optionExplanations: IP 会随网络切换、也被多人共用(NAT),单靠 IP 既误合也漏判。
对;多维浏览器熵组合成伪唯一指纹,才抓得住一机多号和换机这两类信号。
用户名不是设备身份,一个用户可多设备、一设备可多用户,无法识别团伙。
cookie 一清就失效,欺诈者天然会清,不能当稳定设备身份。
optionExplanations_en: IP changes with networks and is shared via NAT, so IP-only both over-merges and misses.
Correct — combining multi-dimensional browser entropy into a pseudo-unique fingerprint catches both one-device-many-accounts and device-switch signals.
A username isn't a device identity; one user has many devices and one device many users, so it can't spot rings.
Cookies vanish on clearing, which fraudsters do by default, so they aren't a stable device identity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由多种浏览器/系统属性拼出的伪唯一设备标识,用于关联同设备的多个账户。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A device fingerprint is a pseudo-unique device identifier assembled from many browser/system attributes, used to link accounts on the same device.

scenario: 你上线了设备指纹,一段时间后欺诈者开始用 VPN、伪造浏览器属性、甚至设备农场来绕过它。
scenario_en: You deploy device fingerprinting; over time fraudsters use VPNs, spoofed browser attributes, and device farms to evade it.
q: 设备指纹被绕过说明什么,该怎么持续应对？
q_en: What does fingerprint evasion reveal, and how do you keep up?
why: 这就是 adversarial arms race:欺诈者用 VPN 换 IP、伪造属性、设备农场制造多样性来绕过。应对不是一次做完,而是持续加入新的浏览器熵源(新的可采集属性),让指纹更难伪造。承认这是持续对抗、要不断演化特征,而不是指望一劳永逸。
why_en: It's an adversarial arms race: fraudsters use VPNs, spoofing, and device farms to evade, so you must keep adding new browser entropy sources rather than expecting a one-time fix.
options: 说明设备指纹彻底失效,应该放弃这一整类特征
这是对抗军备竞赛:欺诈者用 VPN/伪造/设备农场绕过,须持续加入新浏览器熵源让指纹更难伪造
说明只要换更贵的硬件采集一次就永久有效
说明该把阈值调到最松,少拦一点就没人绕了
options_en: Fingerprinting is dead; abandon the whole feature family.
It's an adversarial arms race: fraudsters use VPN/spoofing/device farms, so keep adding new browser entropy sources to make fingerprints harder to forge.
One expensive hardware capture makes it permanently effective.
Loosen the threshold to the max so no one bothers evading.
optionExplanations: 被部分绕过不等于失效,放弃整类特征等于主动送出一个信号维度。
对;军备竞赛的正解是持续演化——不断加新熵源抬高伪造成本,而非一次性方案。
任何一次性采集都会被适应,欺诈者随后就学会伪造,没有永久有效。
调松阈值等于投降,漏放暴增,与'应对绕过'背道而驰。
optionExplanations_en: Partial evasion isn't total failure; abandoning the family hands away a whole signal dimension.
Correct — the arms race is answered by continual evolution: keep adding entropy sources to raise forgery cost, not a one-shot fix.
Any one-time capture gets adapted to as fraudsters learn to forge it — nothing is permanently effective.
Loosening thresholds is surrender, spiking misses — the opposite of countering evasion.

termDefinitions.term: browser entropy source / 浏览器熵源
termDefinitions.meaning: 可采集且在设备间有差异的浏览器/系统属性,越多越难伪造出唯一指纹。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A browser entropy source is a collectable, device-varying browser/system attribute; more of them make a fingerprint harder to forge.

termDefinitions.meaning: 欺诈者批量控制的大量真实/模拟设备,用来制造多样指纹绕过检测。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A device farm is a large pool of real/emulated devices a fraudster controls to generate diverse fingerprints and evade detection.

scenario: 想抓自动化欺诈的'短时间高频'模式:同一张卡一小时刷很多笔、一天打很多不同商户。
scenario_en: You want to catch automation's 'high frequency in a short window': many charges per hour on one card, many distinct merchants per day.
q: 速度(velocity)特征怎么定义,抓的是什么？
q_en: How are velocity features defined, and what do they catch?
why: 速度特征=滑动窗口内的频率:每卡每小时交易数、每天不同商户数、每周 CNP 率。正常用户有天然的速率上限,自动化欺诈会制造可检测的突发。它把'速率异常'量化成特征。计数器要用流式聚合(Redis/DynamoDB)维护,检索 <5ms。
why_en: Velocity features are rates over sliding windows (tx/hour/card, distinct merchants/day, CNP rate/week): legit users have natural rate limits while automation produces detectable bursts.
tradeoff: 速度特征(抓自动化突发但可被分散规避) vs 只看单笔(看不出频率异常)
options: 速度特征=交易金额的大小,金额越大速度越高
速度特征=滑动窗口内的频率(每卡每小时 tx、每天 distinct 商户、每周 CNP 率),抓自动化的突发
速度特征=服务器处理这笔交易的耗时
速度特征=用户打字速度快慢
options_en: Velocity = the size of the transaction amount; bigger amount, higher velocity.
Velocity = rates over sliding windows (tx/hour/card, distinct merchants/day, CNP rate/week), catching automation's bursts.
Velocity = the server's processing time for the transaction.
Velocity = how fast the user types.
whenOtherWins: 若欺诈是低频、单笔大额型(如一次性盗刷一大笔),速度特征几乎无异常,这时更该靠行为基线偏离和设备/图信号,而非速度。
whenOtherWins_en: If the fraud is low-frequency single large charges, velocity shows little anomaly, so lean on behavioral deviation and device/graph signals instead.
optionExplanations: 金额大小是交易特征,不是频率,和速度定义无关。
对;滑窗频率把自动化的突发量化成特征,是速度家族的核心。
服务器耗时是系统延迟,与用户行为速率无关。
打字速度不是支付速率,和交易频率毫无关系。
optionExplanations_en: Amount size is a transaction feature, not a rate, unrelated to velocity.
Correct — sliding-window rates quantify automation's bursts into features, the core of the velocity family.
Server processing time is system latency, unrelated to user behavior rate.
Typing speed isn't payment rate and has nothing to do with transaction frequency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 某实体在滑动时间窗内的动作频率(如每卡每小时交易数),抓自动化的高频突发。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A velocity feature is an entity's action frequency over a sliding time window (tx/hour/card), catching automation's high-frequency bursts.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无卡交易(线上输卡号),欺诈风险高;每周 CNP 率是一个速度特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CNP (Card-Not-Present) is an online no-card transaction with higher fraud risk; CNP rate per week is a velocity feature.

scenario: 你设了速度阈值(如每卡每小时 ≤N 笔),老练的欺诈者把活动摊到很多张卡、很多账户、很多时间窗上,每个都卡在阈值以下。
scenario_en: You set velocity thresholds (≤N tx/hour/card), but sophisticated fraudsters spread activity across many cards, accounts, and windows, each staying under the threshold.
q: 这说明速度特征有什么局限,该怎么补？
q_en: What limitation does this reveal in velocity features, and how do you cover it?
why: 速度是单实体视角:欺诈者把活动分散到多卡/多账户/多窗口,每个实体都低于阈值,就整体绕过了速度检测。补法是图特征——从跨实体关系(共用设备/IP)把这些看似独立的账户连成一个团伙,速度单独不够。
why_en: Velocity is single-entity: fraudsters distribute across cards/accounts/windows to stay under every threshold, so it's insufficient alone — graph features link these seemingly independent entities into one ring.
options: 速度特征没有局限,分散攻击照样能被单实体阈值抓到
速度是单实体视角,分散到多卡/多账户/多窗口即可全部低于阈值绕过;需图特征把跨实体关系连起来
只要把阈值调得足够低就能解决,不需要别的特征
说明该放弃速度特征,改回只看交易金额
options_en: Velocity has no limitation; single-entity thresholds still catch distributed attacks.
Velocity is single-entity; distributing across cards/accounts/windows stays under every threshold, so add graph features to link entities into a ring.
Just set the threshold low enough; no other feature needed.
Abandon velocity and go back to just the transaction amount.
optionExplanations: 分散攻击每个实体都合规,单实体阈值天然看不到跨实体的整体,并非无局限。
对;速度管单实体,跨实体协同要靠图特征连边,两者互补。
阈值调太低会大量误伤正常高频用户,治标反伤召回,还是抓不到分散团伙。
速度对自动化突发仍有用,不该放弃;金额特征更弱,倒退。
optionExplanations_en: In a distributed attack each entity looks compliant, so single-entity thresholds can't see the cross-entity whole — not limitation-free.
Correct — velocity covers single entities, and cross-entity coordination needs graph edges, so they're complementary.
A very low threshold false-declines many legit high-frequency users while still missing distributed rings.
Velocity still helps on automation bursts and shouldn't be dropped; amount is weaker — a regression.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把欺诈活动摊到多个卡/账户/时间窗,使每个单体都低于检测阈值以规避。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distributed attack spreads fraud across many cards/accounts/windows so each entity stays under detection thresholds.

scenario: 打分预算是 sub-50ms,速度特征却要在每次交易时读到最新的滑窗计数。
scenario_en: The scoring budget is sub-50ms, yet velocity features must read up-to-date sliding-window counts on every transaction.
q: 速度计数器怎么维护和读取,才能塞进 sub-50ms 预算？
q_en: How are velocity counters maintained and read to fit the sub-50ms budget?
why: 把速度计数器做成流式聚合,存 Redis/DynamoDB 这类内存/低延迟 KV,每事件增量更新,读取 <5ms——远在 50ms 预算内。为什么不实时扫历史交易算?因为每次现算滑窗要遍历大量记录,几十毫秒都不够;预聚合成计数器后,在线只做一次 O(1) 读。
why_en: Maintain velocity counters as streaming aggregations in a low-latency KV store (Redis/DynamoDB), updated incrementally per event, so retrieval is under 5ms — well within the 50ms budget.
options: 每次交易实时扫描该卡的全部历史交易现算滑窗计数
把计数器落在关系型数据库,打分时跑聚合 SQL 现算
速度计数器做成流式聚合、存 Redis/DynamoDB,每事件增量更新,读取 <5ms,在 50ms 预算内
干脆不算速度特征,以保证延迟达标
options_en: Scan the card's entire transaction history in real time to compute the window on each transaction.
Store counters in a relational DB and run an aggregation SQL at scoring time.
Maintain velocity counters as streaming aggregations in Redis/DynamoDB, incrementally updated per event, retrieved in under 5ms within the 50ms budget.
Skip velocity features entirely to guarantee the latency target.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每来一个事件就增量更新计数/窗口统计,而非查询时从头扫描历史。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Streaming aggregation incrementally updates counts/window stats per incoming event instead of scanning history at query time.

optionExplanations: 每笔交易都现扫全部历史,相当于每次都做一次大范围表扫描,请求量一大立刻拖垮延迟预算。
关系型数据库的聚合查询面向事务一致性设计,不是为亚毫秒点查优化的,现算聚合同样压不进预算。
对;把计数提前用流式聚合算好存进低延迟 KV,线上只做一次索引查找,轻松踩线达标。
跳过速度特征等于放弃唯一能抓自动化高频欺诈的信号维度,只为保延迟牺牲检测能力不划算。
optionExplanations_en: Scanning the full transaction history live turns every request into a large range scan, which blows past the latency budget once volume grows.
A relational aggregation query is built for transactional consistency, not sub-millisecond point lookups, so it still can't fit the budget.
Correct — precompute the counts as an incremental streaming aggregate so scoring is a single fast key lookup instead of a live scan.
Dropping velocity throws away the one signal that catches automated bursts just to hit a latency number — not worth the tradeoff.

scenario: 一个团伙:15 个账户,每个每天只做 2 笔交易,金额、频率单看都完全正常。
scenario_en: A ring: 15 accounts, each doing only 2 transactions a day, each perfectly normal in amount and frequency alone.
q: 为什么个体级特征抓不到这种团伙,该上什么特征？
q_en: Why do individual-level features miss this ring, and what feature catches it?
why: 交易/行为/速度都是孤立评估单个账户,15 个各自 2 笔看每个都正常,团伙隐形。图特征建模实体间关系——账户 A、B 都用过设备 D 就连一条边,揭示共享基础设施的簇。协同信号只在'关系'层面才现形。
why_en: Individual features evaluate accounts in isolation, so 15 accounts at 2 tx/day each look normal, and the ring hides — graph features model relationships between entities, linking accounts that share infrastructure.
tradeoff: 图特征(抓跨账户协同但要建图/异步算) vs 个体特征(实时便宜但孤立评估、漏团伙)
options: 个体特征够用,15 个账户总有一个会超阈值
个体特征孤立评估单账户、团伙隐形;上图特征建模实体间关系(共用设备/IP 连边),揭示协同簇
把速度阈值调到每天 <2 笔就能抓到
给每个账户加更多交易字段即可识别团伙
options_en: Individual features suffice; one of the 15 accounts will exceed a threshold.
Individual features evaluate accounts in isolation and the ring hides; add graph features modeling entity relationships (shared device/IP edges) to reveal coordinated clusters.
Set the velocity threshold to under 2 tx/day and it's caught.
Add more transaction fields per account to identify the ring.
whenOtherWins: 若欺诈是彼此无关联的单打独斗(没有共享设备/IP/资金链),图上根本连不成簇,这时个体级特征反而是主力,图特征帮不上。
whenOtherWins_en: If fraud is isolated lone actors with no shared device/IP/money trail, no cluster forms on the graph, so individual features carry it and graph features don't help.
optionExplanations: 团伙刻意让每个账户都低于阈值,靠单账户超阈是抓不到的。
对;协同信号在关系层,图特征把共享设备/IP 的账户连成簇才看得见团伙。
阈值压到 <2 会把大量正常低频用户误伤,还是没利用跨账户关系。
再多单账户字段仍是孤立视角,补不出跨账户协同信息。
optionExplanations_en: The ring deliberately keeps each account under threshold, so waiting for one to exceed won't catch it.
Correct — coordination lives at the relationship layer, and graph features cluster accounts sharing device/IP to reveal the ring.
Squeezing to under 2 tx/day false-declines many legit low-frequency users and still ignores cross-account relations.
More per-account fields stay in the isolated view and can't recover cross-account coordination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从实体关系图(账户-设备-IP)结构中导出的特征,揭示单账户视角看不到的协同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A graph feature is derived from the entity-relationship graph (accounts-devices-IPs) structure, revealing coordination invisible per-account.

scenario: 要把账户之间的隐藏关联显式化:账户 A 用过设备 D,账户 B 也用过 D。
scenario_en: You want to surface hidden links: account A used device D, and account B also used D.
q: 欺诈图怎么建,能揭示什么？
q_en: How is the fraud graph built, and what does it reveal?
why: 把账户、设备、IP 等当节点,共用关系当边:A 用过 D、B 也用过 D → A 和 B 通过 D 连边。这样把共享操作基础设施的账户聚成簇——一个操作者、多个身份的团伙就现形了。图把'孤立账户'重构成'关系网络'。
why_en: Model accounts/devices/IPs as nodes and shared usage as edges (A used D, B used D → an A-B edge through D), clustering accounts that share operational infrastructure to reveal one operator behind many identities.
options: 把每个账户当孤立点,不连任何边,只看点本身
账户/设备/IP 当节点、共用关系当边(A、B 都用 D 就连边),把共享基础设施的账户聚成团伙簇
只按交易时间顺序连成一条链,不管设备/IP
随机在账户间连边,靠运气找团伙
options_en: Treat each account as an isolated node with no edges, looking only at the node itself.
Nodes are accounts/devices/IPs and edges are shared usage (A and B both used D → an edge), clustering accounts sharing infrastructure into rings.
Chain accounts only by transaction time order, ignoring device/IP.
Randomly connect accounts and hope to find rings.
optionExplanations: 孤立点没有边就退回个体视角,看不到任何协同关系。
对;共用设备/IP 连边把多身份团伙聚成簇,正是欺诈图的建模方式。
按时间连链丢掉了设备/IP 这些揭示协同的关键关系。
随机连边毫无语义,连不出真实的共享基础设施簇。
optionExplanations_en: Isolated nodes with no edges revert to the individual view and show no coordination.
Correct — shared device/IP edges cluster multi-identity rings, exactly how the fraud graph is modeled.
Chaining by time drops device/IP, the key relations revealing coordination.
Random edges have no meaning and can't form real shared-infrastructure clusters.

termDefinitions.meaning: 以账户/设备/IP 为节点、共用关系为边的图,用来发现共享基础设施的团伙簇。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A fraud graph has accounts/devices/IPs as nodes and shared usage as edges, used to find rings sharing infrastructure.

scenario: 从欺诈图里要抽出能区分团伙的信号,喂给欺诈打分。
scenario_en: From the fraud graph you extract signals that discriminate rings for the fraud score.
q: 欺诈图能提供哪些有区分度的团伙信号？(多选)
q_en: Which discriminative ring signals does the fraud graph provide? (multiple)
why: 三个:shared device clustering(账户被同一批设备指纹关联→一个操作者多身份);IP overlap(账户来自同一子网/VPN 出口且时间接近→即便指纹不同也共位);account linkage degree(2 跳内可达的不同账户数,正常约 1-2,团伙操作者可达 10+)。
why_en: Three: shared device clustering (accounts linked by common fingerprints), IP overlap (accounts from the same subnet/VPN exit in a short window), and account linkage degree (# distinct accounts reachable within 2 hops; legit ~1-2, ring 10+).
options: shared device clustering:账户被同一批设备指纹关联,指向一个操作者多身份
IP overlap:账户来自同一子网/VPN 出口且时间接近,即便指纹不同也共位
account linkage degree:2 跳内可达的不同账户数,正常约 1-2、团伙可达 10+
account age:账户注册天数,越老越可能是团伙
options_en: Shared device clustering: accounts linked by common device fingerprints, pointing to one operator with many identities.
IP overlap: accounts from the same subnet/VPN exit in a short window, co-located even if fingerprints differ.
Account linkage degree: # distinct accounts reachable within 2 hops; legit ~1-2, ring 10+.
Account age: days since registration; older means more likely a ring.
optionExplanations: 对;同设备簇是'一机多号'的直接团伙信号。
对;IP overlap 在指纹被伪造时兜底,靠网络共位揭示协同。
对;链接度把'能牵连到多少账户'量化,正常低、团伙高。
错;账户注册天数是单账户属性,不是图结构信号,老账户未必是团伙。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a shared-device cluster is a direct 'one-device-many-accounts' ring signal.
Correct — IP overlap backs up spoofed fingerprints, revealing coordination via network co-location.
Correct — linkage degree quantifies how many accounts one can reach; low for legit, high for rings.
Wrong — registration age is a single-account attribute, not a graph-structure signal, and old accounts aren't necessarily rings.

termDefinitions.term: account linkage degree / 账户链接度
termDefinitions.meaning: 从一个账户出发在图上 2 跳内能到达的不同账户数,团伙操作者远高于正常用户。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Account linkage degree is the number of distinct accounts reachable within 2 hops from an account on the graph, far higher for ring operators.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个账户来自同一子网或 VPN 出口且时间接近,提示可能同源共位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IP overlap is multiple accounts from the same subnet or VPN exit within a short window, hinting at shared co-location.

scenario: account linkage degree = 从某账户出发 2 跳内可达的不同账户数;正常用户约 1-2,某账户测出 12。
scenario_en: Account linkage degree = distinct accounts reachable within 2 hops; legit users ~1-2, and one account measures 12.
q: linkage degree 从 ~1-2 跳到 12,这个数字该怎么用？
q_en: Linkage degree jumping from ~1-2 to 12 — how is this number used?
why: 正常用户在图上牵连极少(~1-2 个账户,来自家人/共用设备);团伙操作者一人管多身份,2 跳内可达 10+。所以 linkage degree 是一个把'团伙嫌疑'量化的连续特征——12 远超正常基线,强烈提示团伙。它不是背的数字,是喂给模型的判别特征,阈值按人群分布定。
why_en: Legit users link to ~1-2 accounts (family/shared devices) while a ring operator reaches 10+ within 2 hops, so a degree of 12 far exceeds the baseline and strongly flags a ring — a discriminative feature, not trivia.
options: 这是要背的固定阈值,考点是记住 1-2 和 10+
linkage degree 越高越安全,12 说明这个账户很可信
正常约 1-2、团伙 10+;12 远超基线是强团伙信号,当连续判别特征喂模型,阈值按人群分布定
12 只是随机波动,和团伙无关,可忽略
options_en: It's a fixed threshold to memorize; the point is recalling 1-2 and 10+.
Higher linkage degree is safer; 12 means this account is very trustworthy.
Legit ~1-2, ring 10+; 12 far exceeds the baseline as a strong ring signal, fed as a continuous discriminative feature with a threshold set by the population distribution.
12 is just random noise, unrelated to rings, and can be ignored.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从起点账户经至多两条边(如账户→设备→另一账户)能到达的节点范围。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Two-hop reachability is the set of nodes reachable via at most two edges (account→device→another account) from a start account.

optionExplanations: 把 1-2/10+ 当死记硬背的门槛,会忽略这其实是要喂给模型的连续特征而非硬编码规则。
说反了;链接度越高说明一人操控越多身份,是团伙风险上升,不是可信度上升。
对;12 远超正常水平,是该喂给模型的连续风险信号,而非要背的硬阈值。
12 不是孤立噪声,而是显著偏离正常基线的信号,忽略它等于放过明显的团伙线索。
optionExplanations_en: Treating 1-2/10+ as numbers to memorize misses that this is meant to be a continuous feature fed to the model, not a hardcoded cutoff.
Backwards — a higher degree means one operator controls more identities, which raises ring risk rather than trust.
Correct — 12 is a clear outlier versus the normal range and should feed the model as a continuous risk signal, not a threshold to recite.
12 isn't isolated noise; it's a signal well outside the normal baseline, and ignoring it drops an obvious ring clue.

scenario: 图特征要在 sub-50ms 打分预算内用上,但在数百万节点的图上做两跳遍历远超 50ms。
scenario_en: Graph features must be usable within the sub-50ms budget, but two-hop traversal over millions of nodes far exceeds 50ms.
q: 两跳图遍历跑不进 50ms,该怎么架构才能实时用上图特征？
q_en: Two-hop traversal can't fit in 50ms — how do you architect to use graph features in real time?
why: 把图特征异步批处理/准实时算好,把节点级属性(簇大小、链接度、簇欺诈率)缓存进 feature store;实时打分路径只做一次 O(1) 检索取缓存值,不在线遍历。代价是图特征有一定滞后(不是当笔最新),但对慢变的团伙结构可接受。
why_en: Precompute graph features async batch / near-real-time and cache node-level attributes (cluster size, linkage degree, cluster fraud rate) in the feature store, so the real-time path just retrieves cached values instead of traversing online.
tradeoff: 异步预计算+缓存(实时 O(1) 取但有滞后) vs 在线两跳遍历(最新但远超 50ms 预算)
options: 在打分时对数百万节点现场做两跳遍历,靠加机器压进 50ms
异步批/准实时算好图特征,把节点属性(簇大小/链接度/簇欺诈率)缓存进 feature store,实时只取缓存
干脆不用图特征,因为它太慢
把整张图加载进每台打分服务器内存,每次请求全图重算
options_en: Do two-hop traversal over millions of nodes live at scoring, brute-forcing into 50ms with more machines.

Precompute graph features async batch / near-real-time and cache node attributes (cluster size/linkage degree/cluster fraud rate) in the feature store; the real-time path only retrieves cached values.
Just skip graph features because they're too slow.
Load the whole graph into every scoring server's memory and recompute the full graph per request.
optionExplanations: 两跳遍历数百万节点是重计算,加机器也压不进 50ms,还成本爆炸。
对;把贵的遍历挪到异步预计算、缓存节点属性,实时只做 O(1) 取,滞后可接受。
放弃图特征就丢了唯一能抓团伙的信号,因噎废食。
全图入内存每请求重算仍是在线重计算,内存和延迟都扛不住。
optionExplanations_en: Two-hop traversal over millions is heavy; more machines still can't fit 50ms and cost explodes.
Correct — move the costly traversal to async precompute and cache node attributes, so real time is an O(1) lookup with acceptable lag.
Dropping graph features loses the only signal that catches rings — throwing out the baby with the bathwater.
Whole-graph in-memory recompute per request is still online heavy compute, breaking both memory and latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预计算并缓存到每个账户节点上的图统计(簇大小、链接度、簇欺诈率),供实时检索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A node-level attribute is a precomputed graph statistic cached on each account node (cluster size, linkage degree, cluster fraud rate) for real-time retrieval.

scenario: 15 个账户,每个每天 2 笔交易,来自不同 IP,但共享同一个设备指纹。
scenario_en: 15 accounts, 2 transactions each per day, from different IPs, but sharing one device fingerprint.
q: 哪类特征最能抓到这个团伙？
q_en: Which feature family best catches this ring?
why: 图特征里的 shared device clustering:虽然 IP 各不相同(躲过 IP overlap)、单账户速度也正常(躲过 velocity),但同一个设备指纹把 15 个账户连成一簇,直接暴露'一台设备多身份'的团伙。IP 不同恰恰说明要靠设备维度而非 IP 维度。
why_en: Shared device clustering in graph features: different IPs evade IP overlap and low per-account velocity evades velocity, but one shared device fingerprint links all 15 into a cluster, exposing 'one device, many identities'.
tradeoff: shared device clustering(跨账户同设备簇、抓分散团伙) vs 速度/IP 特征(被不同 IP+低频规避)
options: 速度特征,因为 15 个账户交易频率高
交易金额特征,金额一定异常
图特征的 shared device clustering:同一设备指纹把 15 个账户连成簇,暴露一机多号团伙
IP overlap 特征,因为它们 IP 相同
options_en: Velocity, because the 15 accounts transact at high frequency.
Transaction amount, since the amount must be anomalous.
Graph shared device clustering: one device fingerprint links all 15 into a cluster, exposing the one-device-many-accounts ring.
IP overlap, because they share the same IP.
whenOtherWins: 若这个团伙改成每台设备只操作一个账户、但都从同一 VPN 出口(同 IP 段),那就换成 IP overlap 更能抓,而不是设备簇。
whenOtherWins_en: If the ring instead used one device per account but all from the same VPN exit (shared subnet), IP overlap would catch it better than device clustering.
optionExplanations: 每账户每天才 2 笔,速度完全正常,抓不到。
题面没说金额异常,单账户金额可以很正常,金额特征无从下手。
对;IP 不同、频率正常都被规避,唯有共享设备指纹把它们连成簇,直接命中。
题面明说 IP 各不相同,IP overlap 正好抓不到,选项与事实矛盾。
optionExplanations_en: At 2 tx/day each, velocity is perfectly normal and catches nothing.
The prompt doesn't say amounts are anomalous, and per-account amounts can be normal, so amount features have nothing to grab.
Correct — different IPs and normal frequency are evaded, and only the shared device fingerprint clusters them, hitting directly.
The prompt states IPs differ, so IP overlap specifically can't catch it — the option contradicts the facts.

termDefinitions.term: shared device clustering / 同设备聚簇
termDefinitions.meaning: 把共享同一设备指纹的多个账户聚成一簇,揭示一个操作者控制的多身份团伙。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Shared device clustering groups accounts sharing one device fingerprint into a cluster, revealing a multi-identity ring under one operator.

scenario: 本课用手工设计的图特征(簇大小、链接度…);下一课要换一种方式从图里拿信号。
scenario_en: This lesson hand-engineers graph features (cluster size, linkage degree); the next lesson takes graph signals differently.
q: 下一课的 GraphSAGE 相对手工图特征改变了什么？
q_en: What does the next lesson's GraphSAGE change relative to hand-engineered graph features?
why: GraphSAGE 直接从图结构学出节点嵌入,替代手工设计的图特征(不再由人去定义'链接度''簇大小'这些统计量),让模型自己聚合邻居信息学表示。手工特征可解释但受限于人能想到的统计量;学习嵌入能捕捉更复杂的结构模式。
why_en: GraphSAGE learns node embeddings directly from graph structure, replacing hand-engineered graph features so the model aggregates neighbor information itself instead of humans defining statistics like linkage degree.
options: GraphSAGE 直接从图结构学节点嵌入,替代人工定义的图统计特征,让模型自己聚合邻居信息学表示
GraphSAGE 只是把手工特征换个名字,本质完全一样
GraphSAGE 取消了图,改回纯个体特征
GraphSAGE 要求把整张图实时遍历,比手工特征更慢且无法预计算
options_en: GraphSAGE learns node embeddings directly from graph structure, replacing human-defined graph statistics so the model aggregates neighbor information itself.
GraphSAGE just renames hand-engineered features; it's essentially identical.
GraphSAGE removes the graph and reverts to purely individual features.
GraphSAGE requires real-time traversal of the whole graph, slower than hand features and impossible to precompute.
optionExplanations: 对;GraphSAGE 学习邻居聚合的嵌入,替代人手设计的图统计量,捕捉更复杂结构。
学习嵌入与手工统计本质不同,不是换名字。
GraphSAGE 恰恰更依赖图结构,不是回到个体特征。
GraphSAGE 的嵌入同样可离线预计算缓存,不是必须实时全图遍历。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — GraphSAGE learns neighbor-aggregated embeddings, replacing hand-designed graph statistics and capturing more complex structure.
Learned embeddings differ fundamentally from hand statistics — not a rename.
GraphSAGE relies more on graph structure, not a return to individual features.
GraphSAGE embeddings can also be precomputed and cached offline, not necessarily real-time full-graph traversal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种图神经网络,通过采样并聚合邻居特征为每个节点学出嵌入,可泛化到新节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GraphSAGE (Graph SAmple and aggreGatE) is a graph neural network that learns node embeddings by sampling and aggregating neighbor features, generalizing to new nodes.

scenario: 训练标签有两种来源:持卡人 chargeback 判定成立的确认欺诈,和规则/分析师标记但未确认的疑似欺诈。
scenario_en: Two label sources: confirmed fraud from cardholder chargebacks ruled in their favor, and suspected fraud flagged by rules/analysts but unconfirmed.
q: 确认欺诈(hard positive)vs 疑似欺诈(soft positive),核心区别是什么？
q_en: Confirmed fraud (hard positive) vs suspected fraud (soft positive) — what's the core difference?
why: 确认欺诈是 chargeback 判成立的硬正例,置信度高、但到达有 30-90 天延迟(chargeback lag);疑似欺诈是规则/分析师标的软正例,即时但有噪声、可能含误报。取舍是置信度/时效:只用确认→学的是 30-90 天前的旧战术;掺入疑似→量大但引入标签噪声伤精度。
why_en: Confirmed fraud is a high-confidence hard positive from a ruled chargeback but arrives with 30-90 day lag, while suspected fraud is an immediate but noisy soft positive that may include false positives.
tradeoff: 确认欺诈(高置信但 30-90 天滞后) vs 疑似欺诈(即时但噪声、含误报)
options: 两者完全等价,都可直接当硬标签用
确认欺诈高置信但滞后 30-90 天(chargeback lag);疑似欺诈即时但有噪声、可能含误报
疑似欺诈比确认欺诈更可信,应优先当硬标签
确认欺诈是即时的,疑似欺诈才有滞后
options_en: The two are equivalent and both usable directly as hard labels.
Confirmed fraud is high-confidence but lags 30-90 days (chargeback lag); suspected fraud is immediate but noisy and may include false positives.
Suspected fraud is more reliable than confirmed and should be the hard label.
Confirmed fraud is immediate; only suspected fraud lags.
optionExplanations: 两者置信度和时效差别很大,不能等同直接当硬标签。
对;确认高置信但滞后,疑似即时但噪声,这正是标签设计要权衡的两轴。
疑似未确认、含误报,可信度低于确认,不该当硬标签。
说反了:确认欺诈才有 chargeback lag,疑似是即时标记的。
optionExplanations_en: Their confidence and timing differ greatly, so they can't be equated as hard labels.
Correct — confirmed is high-confidence but lagged, suspected is immediate but noisy — the two axes label design must weigh.
Suspected is unconfirmed with false positives, less reliable than confirmed, so not a hard label.
Backwards — confirmed fraud carries the chargeback lag, while suspected is flagged immediately.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持卡人向发卡行申诉某笔交易,判成立即为确认欺诈的硬正例,但有 30-90 天延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A chargeback is a cardholder disputing a transaction with the issuer; a ruling in their favor is a confirmed-fraud hard positive, arriving 30-90 days later.

termDefinitions.term: hard vs soft positive / 硬正例 vs 软正例
termDefinitions.meaning: 硬正例=高置信确认的欺诈;软正例=疑似但未确认,训练时给更低权重。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hard positive is high-confidence confirmed fraud; a soft positive is suspected but unconfirmed, given lower training weight.

scenario: 确认欺诈标签(chargeback 判定)在交易发生后 30-90 天才到达。
scenario_en: Confirmed-fraud labels (chargeback rulings) arrive 30-90 days after the transaction.
q: chargeback lag 30-90 天这个数字,约束了哪些设计？
q_en: What does the 30-90 day chargeback lag constrain in the design?
why: 30-90 天是给定的业务延迟(不是公式)。它约束三件事:(1)只用确认标签训练=在学 30-90 天前的旧战术,可能已失效;(2)负样本采样窗要 ≥90 天(交易 90 天没被拒付才较安全地当负例);(3)重训节奏必须等标签'成熟',否则近期交易标签还没到齐。
why_en: The 30-90 days is a given business delay: it means confirmed-only training learns 30-90-day-old tactics, negatives need a ≥90-day sampling window, and retraining must wait for labels to mature.
options: 这个数字要死记,考点就是记住 30-90 天
chargeback lag 说明可以立刻用最新交易的确认标签,没有时效问题
给定业务延迟:只用确认标签=学旧战术;负样本窗须 ≥90 天;重训要等标签成熟,近期交易标签还没到齐
30-90 天说明欺诈会在 30-90 天后自动消失,无需建模
options_en: Memorize the number; the point is recalling 30-90 days.
The chargeback lag means you can immediately use confirmed labels on the newest transactions with no timing issue.
A given business delay: confirmed-only training learns old tactics; the negative window must be ≥90 days; retraining waits for labels to mature since recent transactions' labels haven't all arrived.
30-90 days means fraud auto-disappears after 30-90 days, needing no modeling.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从交易到 chargeback 确认之间 30-90 天的延迟,使确认标签天生滞后。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Chargeback lag is the 30-90 day delay from a transaction to a confirmed chargeback, making confirmed labels inherently late.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一笔交易的最终标签随时间逐渐到齐;成熟前纳入训练会用到不完整标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Label maturation is a transaction's final label gradually arriving over time; training on it before maturation uses incomplete labels.

optionExplanations: 死记数字没用;30-90 天是要拿去约束采样窗口和重训节奏的业务参数,不是背诵题。
说反了;确认标签正是要等 chargeback 裁定才产生,天生滞后,不可能立刻拿到最新交易的判定。
对;这个延迟直接决定负样本窗口要多长、训练该等多久标签才算齐全。
欺诈不会因为时间到了就消失,30-90 天只是拒付裁定送达的时间窗,不是欺诈的有效期限。
optionExplanations_en: Memorizing the number misses the point — 30-90 days is a business parameter that sets the sampling window and retraining cadence, not a trivia fact.
Backwards — a confirmed label only exists after a chargeback ruling, so it's inherently delayed, never available immediately on the newest transactions.
Correct — this delay directly sets how long the negative window must be and how long training should wait for labels to settle.
Fraud doesn't lapse on a timer; 30-90 days is just how long a chargeback ruling takes to arrive, not a window when fraud stops.

scenario: 手上有三种信号:chargeback 确认的欺诈、分析师标记但未确认的、以及很久都没有任何标记的交易。
scenario_en: You have three signals: chargeback-confirmed fraud, analyst-flagged-but-unconfirmed, and transactions with no flag for a long time.
q: 该怎么把这三类做成训练标签,而不是一刀切当 1/0？
q_en: How should you turn these into training labels instead of hard 1/0?
why: 用分层加权:chargeback 确认的欺诈权重 1.0(硬正例);分析师确认的标记权重 0.3-0.5(软正例,承认它有噪声);交易发生后 90+ 天仍无任何标记的当负例。这样既用上疑似标签的量,又按可信度打折,避免噪声全额污染。
why_en: Use tiered weighting: confirmed chargebacks weight 1.0, analyst-confirmed flags 0.3-0.5, and transactions with no flag for 90+ days become negatives — using suspected volume while discounting it by trust.
tradeoff: 分层加权(用上疑似量但按可信度打折) vs 全当硬 1/0(要么丢量要么被噪声污染)
options: 把确认和疑似都当权重 1.0 的硬正例,一视同仁
只用确认欺诈当正例,疑似标签全部丢弃
确认 chargeback 权重 1.0;分析师标记权重 0.3-0.5;交易后 90+ 天无标记当负例
把所有交易都当负例,只在被拒付时临时改成正例
options_en: Treat both confirmed and suspected as weight-1.0 hard positives, all equal.
Use only confirmed fraud as positives and discard all suspected labels.
Confirmed chargebacks weight 1.0; analyst flags 0.3-0.5; no flag for 90+ days becomes negatives.
Treat all transactions as negatives, flipping to positive only when charged back.
whenOtherWins: 若分析师标记的准确率经校准后其实很高(接近确认),可把其权重上调、接近 1.0;权重是可调的,反映该来源的实际可信度。
whenOtherWins_en: If analyst flags, once calibrated, prove nearly as accurate as confirmed, raise their weight toward 1.0 — weights are tunable to each source's real reliability.
optionExplanations: 把噪声疑似当 1.0 硬正例会把误报全额灌进训练,拉低精度。
全丢疑似标签损失大量信号,尤其近期(确认还没到)时更亏。
对;按来源可信度分层加权,既用量又控噪,是标准的分层标注策略。
全当负例再临时翻正忽略了疑似信号,也没处理 90 天成熟窗。
optionExplanations_en: Treating noisy suspected as 1.0 hard positives pours false positives into training, cutting precision.
Discarding all suspected loses much signal, especially recently when confirmed hasn't arrived.
Correct — tiered weighting by source reliability uses volume while controlling noise — the standard tiered-labeling strategy.
All-negative-then-flip ignores suspected signals and doesn't handle the 90-day maturation window.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按标签来源可信度分配不同训练权重(确认 1.0、疑似 0.3-0.5),兼顾量与噪声。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tiered labeling assigns training weights by source reliability (confirmed 1.0, suspected 0.3-0.5), balancing volume and noise.

scenario: 为了标签干净,团队决定只用 chargeback 确认的欺诈训练,完全不碰疑似标签。
scenario_en: For clean labels, the team trains only on chargeback-confirmed fraud, ignoring all suspected labels.
q: 只用确认欺诈训练,会带来什么后果链？
q_en: What consequence chain follows from training only on confirmed fraud?
why: 确认标签有 30-90 天 lag → 只用它 = 模型学的是 1-3 个月前的欺诈战术 → 欺诈者早已换招 → 对当下新战术检测滞后。而掺入疑似标签能补近期信号、加量,但引入噪声降精度。所以要分层加权折中,而不是走极端只用确认。
why_en: Confirmed labels lag 30-90 days, so confirmed-only means learning 1-3-month-old tactics while fraudsters have already shifted, degrading detection of current tactics — the fix is tiered weighting, not the extreme.
tradeoff: 只用确认(标签干净但滞后、学旧战术) vs 掺入疑似(近期加量但有噪声降精度)
options: 没有后果,只用确认标签最干净、效果最好
确认标签滞后 30-90 天→模型学 1-3 月前旧战术→欺诈者已换招→对新战术滞后;应分层加权掺入疑似补量
只用确认会让模型对新战术更敏感,是优点
只用确认会导致 GPU 过热,是硬件问题
options_en: No consequence; confirmed-only is the cleanest and best.
Confirmed labels lag 30-90 days → the model learns 1-3-month-old tactics → fraudsters already shifted → detection lags on new tactics; tiered-weight in suspected to add recent volume.
Confirmed-only makes the model more sensitive to new tactics — an advantage.
Confirmed-only overheats the GPU — a hardware problem.
optionExplanations: 干净不等于有效:滞后标签让模型永远慢欺诈者一步,不是最好。
对;lag→旧战术→被绕过,补疑似加近期量、按可信度打折,是正解。
只用滞后标签恰恰对新战术更迟钝,不是更敏感,说反了。
GPU 过热与标签时效毫无关系,是无关项。
optionExplanations_en: Clean isn't effective: lagged labels keep the model a step behind fraudsters, not the best.
Correct — lag → old tactics → evasion; add suspected for recent volume, discounted by reliability, is the fix.
Lagged-only is less, not more, sensitive to new tactics — backwards.
GPU overheating has nothing to do with label timing — an irrelevant option.

termDefinitions.meaning: 欺诈战术随时间变化,使旧标签训练的模型逐渐失效,须靠近期数据跟上。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concept drift is fraud tactics changing over time, making models trained on old labels decay, requiring recent data to keep up.

scenario: 因为 chargeback lag,一笔近期交易的最终标签可能还没到齐,过早纳入训练会用到不完整标签。
scenario_en: Because of chargeback lag, a recent transaction's final label may not be complete, and including it too early uses incomplete labels.
q: 怎么知道一笔交易'最早什么时候'纳入训练才安全？
q_en: How do you know the earliest safe point to include a transaction in training?
why: 跟踪 label maturation curve:统计'距交易 X 天时,最终标签已到齐的比例'。这条曲线告诉你标签在多少天后基本稳定(如 90 天到 95%),从而定出最早安全纳入训练的时间点——太早纳入会把'还没被拒付'的欺诈误当负例。
why_en: Track the label maturation curve — the percentage of final labels arrived versus days since the transaction — which tells you when labels stabilize and thus the earliest safe point to include a transaction in training.
tradeoff: 等标签成熟再纳入(标签准但数据更旧) vs 早纳入(数据新但把未成熟的欺诈误当负例)
options: 凭感觉定个天数,不用统计
跟踪 label maturation curve(距交易 X 天最终标签到齐比例),据此定最早安全纳入训练的时间点
交易一发生就立即纳入训练,不等标签
永远只用一年前的交易,越旧越安全
options_en: Pick a number of days by gut feel, no statistics.
Track the label maturation curve (% of final labels arrived by day X since the transaction) to set the earliest safe inclusion point.
Include a transaction in training the moment it happens, without waiting for labels.
Only ever use transactions from a year ago — older is safer.
whenOtherWins: 若某类欺诈的确认几乎是即时的(如实时反欺诈规则秒级判定),它的 maturation 很快,可以早得多地纳入,不必等 90 天。
whenOtherWins_en: If a fraud type's confirmation is near-instant (a real-time rule ruling in seconds), its maturation is fast and it can be included far earlier than 90 days.
optionExplanations: 凭感觉定天数会系统性偏早或偏晚,不如用数据说话。
对;maturation 曲线量化'标签几天后稳定',给出最早安全纳入点,兼顾新鲜与正确。
立即纳入会把还没到齐标签的交易当负例,系统性污染训练。
只用一年前数据虽标签成熟,但严重损失新鲜度、追不上概念漂移。
optionExplanations_en: Gut-feel days are systematically early or late; data is better.
Correct — the maturation curve quantifies when labels stabilize, giving the earliest safe inclusion point, balancing freshness and correctness.
Immediate inclusion labels not-yet-matured transactions as negatives, systematically polluting training.
Year-old-only has mature labels but badly loses freshness and lags concept drift.

termDefinitions.term: label maturation curve / 标签成熟曲线
termDefinitions.meaning: '距交易 X 天时最终标签已到齐比例'的曲线,用来定最早可安全纳入训练的时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The label maturation curve plots the percentage of final labels arrived versus days since the transaction, setting the earliest safe training-inclusion time.

scenario: 有人提议用普通的随机交叉验证(打乱后随机分 train/test)来评估欺诈模型,离线 AUC-PR 高得很好看。
scenario_en: Someone proposes standard random cross-validation (shuffle, then random train/test split) for the fraud model, with a great-looking offline AUC-PR.
q: 为什么随机 CV 对欺诈数据无效,会怎样？
q_en: Why is random CV invalid for fraud data, and what happens?
why: 欺诈数据是时间有序的。随机打乱会让训练集里混进'测试交易之后'才发生的信息(未来速度计数、几十天后才来的 chargeback 标签),泄露未来→离线指标虚高、上线却崩。正解是时间切分(temporal holdout):按截止时间训练在前、测试在后,模拟生产。
why_en: Fraud data is time-ordered, so shuffling mixes post-test-transaction information (future velocity counts, chargebacks arriving weeks later) into training, leaking the future so offline looks great but production fails.
tradeoff: 时间切分(模拟生产、诚实) vs 随机 CV(离线虚高但泄露未来、上线崩)
options: 随机 CV 完全有效,离线高就代表线上好
欺诈数据时间有序;随机打乱把未来信息(未来速度/后到的 chargeback)混进训练→泄露未来→离线虚高上线崩;应用时间切分
随机 CV 只是慢一点,结论仍然可信
随机 CV 无效是因为欺诈样本太少,过采样即可修复
options_en: Random CV is fully valid; high offline means good production.
Fraud data is time-ordered; shuffling mixes future information (future velocity, later chargebacks) into training → leaks the future → inflated offline, production collapse; use temporal holdout.
Random CV is just slower; the conclusion is still trustworthy.
Random CV is invalid because fraud samples are too few; oversampling fixes it.
optionExplanations: 随机 CV 泄露未来,离线高是假象,与线上无关联。
对;时间有序数据一打乱就泄露未来,必须时间切分才诚实反映生产。
问题不是速度而是未来泄露导致结论本身错误,慢不慢无关。
样本少是另一个问题,随机 CV 的致命伤是时间泄露,过采样不解决。
optionExplanations_en: Random CV leaks the future, so a high offline is illusory and uncorrelated with production.
Correct — shuffling time-ordered data leaks the future, so temporal splitting is required to honestly reflect production.
The issue isn't speed but that future leakage makes the conclusion itself wrong.
Few samples is a separate issue; random CV's fatal flaw is temporal leakage, which oversampling doesn't fix.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据分成多折轮流当训练/验证的评估法;对时间有序的欺诈数据随机分折会泄露未来。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CV (Cross-Validation) rotates data folds as train/validation; random folds leak the future for time-ordered fraud data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按时间截止点训练在前、测试在后,模拟'用过去预测未来'的生产设置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Temporal holdout trains before a cutoff time and tests after, simulating the production setting of predicting the future from the past.

scenario: 即便用了时间切分,欺诈特征管线里仍有几条隐蔽的数据泄露路径。
scenario_en: Even with temporal splitting, several subtle data-leakage paths remain in the fraud feature pipeline.
q: 欺诈建模里有哪些典型的数据泄露向量？(多选)
q_en: Which are typical data-leakage vectors in fraud modeling? (multiple)
why: 三条:(1)未来速度特征——计数器把交易时间点之后的事件也算进去了;(2)未来标签泄露——用 60 天后才提交的 chargeback 去构造它之前那些交易的特征;(3)feature store 状态泄露——用当前 feature store 状态,而不是重建成'该交易发生时刻'的历史状态。
why_en: Three: future velocity features (counters include events after the transaction timestamp), future label leakage (a chargeback filed 60 days later used to compute features for earlier transactions), and feature-store state leakage (using current state instead of reconstructing it as-of transaction time).
options: 未来速度特征:计数器把交易时间点之后发生的事件也算进去了
未来标签泄露:用 60 天后才提交的 chargeback 去算它之前交易的特征
feature store 状态泄露:用当前状态而非重建成交易发生时刻的历史状态
特征列命名不规范:字段名拼写错误导致泄露
options_en: Future velocity features: counters include events happening after the transaction timestamp.
Future label leakage: a chargeback filed 60 days later used to compute features for earlier transactions.
Feature-store state leakage: using current state instead of reconstructing it as-of the transaction time.
Feature-column naming: misspelled field names cause leakage.
optionExplanations: 对;速度计数若含交易后事件,就用未来信息预测过去,是典型泄露。
对;拿后到的标签回填历史特征,把答案偷偷喂进输入。
对;不重建历史 feature 状态就等于用未来的画像值,离线会虚高。
错;字段拼写错误是数据质量/bug,不是时间维度的未来泄露。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — velocity counts including post-transaction events use future information to predict the past — classic leakage.
Correct — backfilling historical features with later-arriving labels sneaks the answer into the input.
Correct — not reconstructing historical feature state means using future profile values, inflating offline metrics.
Wrong — misspelled field names are a data-quality/bug issue, not temporal future leakage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练特征里混进了预测时刻本不该有的未来信息,导致离线指标虚高、线上崩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data leakage is future information the prediction time shouldn't have leaking into training features, inflating offline metrics while production fails.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 feature store 还原成'交易发生那一刻'的历史状态,避免用到之后的值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: As-of reconstruction restores the feature store to its historical state at the transaction moment, avoiding later values.

scenario: 构造历史训练样本时,图省事直接读了当前 feature store 的值(如账户当前的簇欺诈率、当前行为画像)。
scenario_en: Building historical training samples, you conveniently read current feature-store values (the account's current cluster fraud rate, current behavioral profile).
q: 用当前 feature store 状态构造历史样本,会怎样,该怎么做？
q_en: What happens if you use current feature-store state for historical samples, and what should you do?
why: 当前状态已经吸收了交易之后发生的一切(账户后来暴露成欺诈、簇欺诈率飙升),等于把未来偷偷喂进特征→离线 AUC-PR 虚高、上线崩。必须把 feature store 重建成'该交易发生时刻'的历史状态(as-of),尽管重放历史特征很贵,但不做就高估生产表现。
why_en: Current state has absorbed everything after the transaction (the account later exposed as fraud, cluster fraud rate spiked), leaking the future into features so offline inflates and production fails — you must reconstruct feature-store state as-of the transaction time.
options: 没问题,当前状态最新最准,直接用即可
当前状态含交易后信息→未来泄露→离线虚高上线崩;须把 feature store 重建成交易发生时刻的历史状态(as-of)
只会让训练变慢,不影响指标可信度
把当前状态加噪声就能消除泄露,不必重建历史
options_en: No problem; current state is the freshest and most accurate — use it directly.
Current state contains post-transaction information → future leakage → inflated offline, production collapse; reconstruct feature-store state as-of the transaction time.
It only slows training, without affecting metric trustworthiness.
Just add noise to current state to remove leakage, no need to reconstruct history.
optionExplanations: '最新'恰恰是问题:它含了交易之后的信息,对历史样本就是未来泄露。
对;当前状态泄露未来,必须 as-of 重建历史 feature 状态,尽管昂贵但必要。
泄露让指标本身失真、结论错误,不只是慢的问题。
加噪声掩盖不了系统性的未来信息,唯一正解是按时点重建。
optionExplanations_en: 'Freshest' is exactly the problem: it contains post-transaction information, which for historical samples is future leakage.
Correct — current state leaks the future, so as-of reconstruction of historical feature state is required, expensive but necessary.
Leakage distorts the metric itself and the conclusion, not merely speed.
Adding noise can't hide systematic future information; the only fix is as-of reconstruction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练每个样本只使用其时间戳当刻及之前的信息,杜绝用到未来值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Point-in-time correctness means each training sample uses only information available at or before its timestamp, never future values.

scenario: 欺诈战术随季节和时间演化,你想让离线评估同时反映概念漂移和季节性,而不是只测一个时间点。
scenario_en: Fraud tactics evolve with season and time, and you want offline evaluation to reflect both concept drift and seasonality, not one time point.
q: 该用什么评估方案来捕捉概念漂移和季节性？
q_en: What evaluation scheme captures both concept drift and seasonality?
why: 用滑动窗口评估:比如训练第 1-6 月、验证第 7 月、测试第 8 月,然后整体往前滑,重复。每次滑动都在'用过去预测紧邻的未来',多个窗口合起来既暴露概念漂移(战术随时间变),又覆盖不同季节。单一时间切分只看一个时点,看不出漂移趋势。
why_en: Use sliding-window evaluation: train months 1-6, validate 7, test 8, then slide forward and repeat, so multiple windows expose concept drift over time and span different seasons.
tradeoff: 滑动窗口(多窗口显漂移+季节但评估更重) vs 单次时间切分(便宜但只看一个时点、看不出趋势)
options: 随机 CV,反正多折就能覆盖季节
滑动窗口评估:训练 1-6 月、验证 7 月、测试 8 月,再整体前滑重复,暴露概念漂移与季节性
只用最后一个月做一次训练测试,越新越好
把所有月份混在一起测一个平均值
options_en: Random CV, since many folds cover seasons anyway.
Sliding-window evaluation: train months 1-6, validate 7, test 8, then slide forward and repeat, exposing concept drift and seasonality.
Just one train/test on the last month — newer is better.
Mix all months together and test one average.
whenOtherWins: 若数据量很小、时间跨度短、几乎没有漂移或季节性,单次时间切分就够,滑动窗口的多轮评估成本反而不划算。
whenOtherWins_en: If data is small, spans a short time, and shows little drift or seasonality, a single temporal split suffices and sliding windows aren't worth the extra evaluation cost.
optionExplanations: 随机 CV 打乱时间会泄露未来,多折也改变不了这个致命问题。
对;多个前滑窗口既显漂移又跨季节,是时间序列欺诈的标准评估法。
只测一个月看不到跨时间的漂移趋势,也可能撞上单一季节偏差。
混月求平均抹掉了时间维度,漂移和季节性都被平均没了。
optionExplanations_en: Random CV shuffles time and leaks the future; more folds don't fix that fatal flaw.
Correct — multiple forward-sliding windows show drift and span seasons — the standard eval for time-series fraud.
Testing one month misses cross-time drift trends and may hit a single-season bias.
Averaging mixed months erases the time dimension, averaging away both drift and seasonality.

termDefinitions.term: sliding-window evaluation / 滑动窗口评估
termDefinitions.meaning: 按时间划分训练/验证/测试窗口并逐步前滑,反复评估以捕捉漂移与季节性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sliding-window evaluation partitions train/validate/test by time and slides forward repeatedly to capture drift and seasonality.

scenario: 离线评估 AUC-PR 高达 0.95,一上线却掉到约 0.70。
scenario_en: Offline AUC-PR is a stellar 0.95, but in production it drops to about 0.70.
q: 离线 0.95、线上 0.70 这个落差,最该先怀疑什么？
q_en: Offline 0.95 vs production 0.70 — what should you suspect first?
why: 巨大的离线-线上落差是数据泄露的头号症状。离线 0.95 多半是因为特征里混进了未来信息(未来速度、后到标签、当前 feature store 状态),线上没有未来可看就打回原形到 0.70。先查三条泄露向量、改用时间切分+时点重建,而不是先去调模型超参。
why_en: A large offline-to-production gap is the primary symptom of data leakage: the 0.95 likely comes from future information in features, which vanishes online, dropping to 0.70 — check the leakage vectors first.
options: 先怀疑线上服务器太慢,加机器就能回到 0.95
先怀疑模型欠拟合,加大模型就能提到 0.95
巨大离线-线上落差是数据泄露头号症状:离线掺了未来信息,先查三条泄露向量+改时间切分/时点重建
这是正常波动,0.95 到 0.70 不用管
options_en: Suspect slow production servers first; more machines restore 0.95.
Suspect underfitting first; a bigger model reaches 0.95.
A large offline-to-production gap is the primary leakage symptom: offline mixed in future information — check the three leakage vectors first and switch to temporal splitting / as-of reconstruction.
It's normal variance; 0.95 to 0.70 needs no action.

termDefinitions.meaning: 精确率-召回率曲线下面积,类别极不均衡(如欺诈稀有)时比 ROC-AUC 更敏感。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AUC-PR (Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve) is more sensitive than ROC-AUC under extreme class imbalance like rare fraud.

optionExplanations: 服务器延迟慢会拖垮吞吐,但不会把 AUC-PR 从 0.95 打到 0.70,方向找错了。
欠拟合会让离线分数本身就不高,而不是离线高、线上骤降,症状对不上。
对;这种量级的落差几乎总是训练特征偷看了未来,该先排查泄露而不是调参。
0.25 的落差远超正常波动范围,放着不查等于放过一个真实的泄露漏洞。
optionExplanations_en: Slow servers hurt throughput, not the model's own precision-recall curve — that wouldn't drag AUC-PR from 0.95 to 0.70.
Underfitting would make the offline score low to begin with, not high offline and collapsing in production — wrong symptom.
Correct — a gap this large almost always means training features peeked at the future; chase leakage before touching hyperparameters.
A 0.25-point drop is far outside normal variance, and ignoring it lets a real leakage bug go unfixed.

q: 把一笔交易的欺诈标签生命周期排成正确的时间顺序:
q_en: Order the fraud-label lifecycle of a transaction correctly in time:
steps: 交易发生,实时打分,此刻还没有任何欺诈标签
规则/分析师可能即时标记为疑似欺诈(软正例,权重 0.3-0.5)
30-90 天内持卡人拒付且判成立→确认欺诈(硬正例,权重 1.0);或 90+ 天无任何标记→当负例
标签成熟后,这笔交易才安全纳入训练集
why: 生命周期:交易发生(无标签)→ 可能被即时标为疑似(软 0.3-0.5)→ 30-90 天内 chargeback 确认(硬 1.0)或 90+ 天无标记转负例 → 标签成熟后才纳入训练。关键是必须等标签成熟,否则把未定的欺诈误当负例、造成未来标签泄露。
why_en: The lifecycle: transaction (no label) → possibly flagged suspected (soft 0.3-0.5) → confirmed by chargeback within 30-90 days (hard 1.0) or turned negative after 90+ days with no flag → included in training only after maturation.
diagram:
flowchart LR A["交易发生
无标签"] --> B["即时疑似标记
软 0.3-0.5"] B --> C["30-90 天 chargeback 确认硬 1.0
或 90+ 天无标记转负"] C --> D["标签成熟
纳入训练"]

termDefinitions.term: negative sampling window / 负样本窗口
termDefinitions.meaning: 交易发生后需等待的时长(≥90 天)无任何欺诈标记,才较安全地把它当负例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The negative sampling window is the wait (≥90 days) with no fraud flag before a transaction is safely treated as a negative.

scenario: 收尾:一句话串起欺诈特征工程与数据策略的主线。
scenario_en: Wrap-up: one line tying together fraud feature engineering and data strategy.
q: 补全欺诈检测数据策略的骨架:
q_en: Fill in the skeleton of the fraud-detection data strategy:
text: 特征:交易/行为/设备/{{速度}}四大表格家族 + {{图}}特征抓团伙;单一信号会被 {{对抗}}适应,故多家族互补。标签:确认 chargeback 权重 1.0、疑似 0.3-0.5,受 {{chargeback lag}} 30-90 天约束、要等标签成熟。评估:欺诈时间有序,必须用 {{时间切分}}+滑动窗口,杜绝未来泄露,否则离线虚高上线崩。
text_en: Features: four tabular families transaction/behavioral/device/{{velocity}} plus {{graph}} features for rings; a single signal gets {{adversarially}} adapted, so families are complementary. Labels: confirmed chargebacks weight 1.0, suspected 0.3-0.5, constrained by {{chargeback lag}} of 30-90 days and label maturation. Evaluation: fraud is time-ordered, so use {{temporal holdout}} plus sliding windows to block future leakage.
why: 一句话主线:多家族+图特征应对适应性攻击、分层标签+成熟窗应对 chargeback lag、时间切分+滑动窗口应对时间泄露。三块都围绕'欺诈者会变、标签会滞后、数据有时间序'这三个约束。
why_en: The one-line spine: complementary families plus graph features counter adaptation, tiered labels plus maturation handle chargeback lag, and temporal holdout plus sliding windows block time leakage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 交易到 chargeback 确认间 30-90 天的延迟,约束标签成熟与重训节奏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Chargeback lag is the 30-90 day delay from transaction to confirmed chargeback, constraining label maturation and retraining cadence.
